correctness.rationale: Independently solved the backward ODE -Fyy=1 with F_y(0)=tF(0), F_y(1)=-(S-t)F(1). This yields F= -y^2/2+(1+(S-t)/2)(1+ty)/(S+t(S-t)). SymPy independently differentiated this rational expression and confirmed the claimed quadratic g/(S+t(S-t))^2 exactly, the rescaled S H(p)+K(p) relation, and H(p0)=(2y-1)^3/32. The derivative polynomial g has g(0)<0<g(S), and g_t(0)=S(1-y)+2>0 and g_t(S)=Sy+2>0, proving its derivative positive on [0,S] and a unique strict global interior optimum for all y, including endpoints. The implicit derivative and H sign establish strict budget monotonicity except y=1/2; boundary y=0 yields exact S-t*=sqrt(S+4)-2, which must be handled separately from the nonuniform interior expansion. Independently bracketed roots for 25 (S,y) pairs; no continuum result inferred from those tests.

value.rationale: Splitting a fixed physical endpoint-reaction budget to minimize the first arrival time is a natural operational and analytic optimization. The result is a complete parametric classification, including strict interior optimality despite endpoint starts, monotone budget crossover and an unusual sqrt(S) distant-reactivity boundary layer, not an arbitrary numerical improvement.
